Yuvraj Singh Appointed Delhi Capitals Batting Coach

Yuvraj Singh has been appointed as the assistant and batting coach for the Delhi Capitals team for the upcoming Indian Premier League (IPL) season. This appointment sees him reunite with Sourav Ganguly, who is also associated with the Delhi Capitals.
